detail.longDescription: I was at a restaurant last Saturday, overhearing a couple in their 20s on a first Tinder date: "Yeah, I’m actually an artist. I do all kinds of art, and I’m pretty proficient at it." "Oh yeah? Can I see it? Do you have an Instagram?" "Sure! Look." He opens his phone. The woman looks at it with pure revulsion. "This is fucking AI." "Well, yes. I’m an AI artist. I also write and compose music with it, and I’m also very good at it." "You’re not good at anything. Actually, you’re completely useless. Use your fucking brain. I’m completely opposed to this, and I'm not interested at all." Lectures and shames him for the next 20 minutes A long silence followed, replaced by awkward small talk about the weather. Don't worry, guys. These AI tech bros won't even be able to reproduce. This mindset won't survive the dating pool. It’s no surprise that nobody wants a partner who is completely incapable of critical thinking, or any real thinking at all. They’ll probably end up fucking robots, but just that. # AI # Dating # LLMs # AIBro # TechBro # Tech # Art # Writing # Music # ChatGPT # Claude # Gemini # Design
